answer.value: Only limited curation details are given. Data filtering is used in pre-training as a first step to mitigate Child Safety risk. For safety fine-tuning, LLM-based classifiers select high-quality prompts and responses, and human-generated vendor data is combined with synthetic data. The card gives no details on cleaning, deduplication or normalisation of the pretraining data.
quotes: We’ve developed many large language model (LLM)-based classifiers that enable us to thoughtfully select high-quality prompts and responses, enhancing data quality control.
We employ a multi-faceted approach to data collection, combining human-generated data from our vendors with synthetic data to mitigate potential safety risks.
We leverage pre-training methods like data filtering as a first step in mitigating Child Safety risk in our model.
